retained_inputs.role: retained classical group and linear algebra facts
scope: Finite irreducible matrix algebra with commuting field F is End_F(V); irreducible modules of direct products over an algebraic closure are tensor products.
Natural PSL3/PSU3 modules are irreducible; exact SL/SU/projective and orthogonal orders and scalar centers.
Characteristic-two Dickson invariant equals rank(g-I) modulo 2 and its kernel is Omega.
Klein identifications PSL4(q)=Omega6+(q), PSU4(q)=Omega6-(q) for even q, natural six-dimensional irreducibility; Wilson The Finite Simple Groups §3.11.2 for minus type.
